violations.why: After irq_jasper runs and enables interrupt 2, irq_nimbus can preempt the task between the two reads of v_falcon and change it. The two conditions can then disagree.
irq_nimbus can run between the task's two reads of v_meadow once irq_jasper has set v_hazel and enabled interrupt 2. It writes v_meadow = 5, so the two reads can return different values.
